test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_t1 (c1 String, c2 Nullable(String), c3 Nullable(String), c4 Nullable(String), c5 Nullable(String), c6 Nullable(String), c7 Nullable(String), c8 Nullable(Float64), c9 Nullable(String), c10 Nullable(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_t2 (c1 String, c2 Nullable(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_t3 (c1 String, c2 DateTime, c3 Nullable(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c1, c2)
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_posts (id UInt64, title String, body String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_comments (post_id UInt64, created DateTime, author String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY post_id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lazy_sort_t1 SELECT toString(number), if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, concat('u', toString(number), '@example.com')), concat('t', toString(number % 7)), concat('k', toString(number % 50)), concat('m', toString(number % 500)), if(number % 3 = 0, 'g', ''), concat('b', toString(number % 1000)), (number % 1000) / 10., 'x', 'p' FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_t2 SELECT toString(number), number % 5 FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_t3 SELECT toString(number % 1000000), toDateTime('2024-02-01 00:00:00') + number, concat('10.0.', toString(number % 256), '.', toString(number % 199)) FROM numbers(3000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_posts SELECT number, concat('title ', toString(number)), randomPrintableASCII(2000) FROM numbers(100000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_comments SELECT number % 100000, toDateTime('2024-01-01 00:00:00') + intHash32(number) % 10000000, concat('user', toString(number % 1000)) FROM numbers(500000)
test.query: SELECT t1.c1 AS a1, t1.c2 AS a2, t3.c3 AS a3, t1.c3 AS a4, t1.c4 AS a5, t1.c5 AS a6, t1.c6 AS a7, t1.c7 AS a8, t3.c2 AS a9, t1.c8 AS a10, t1.c9 AS a11 FROM lazy_sort_t1 AS t1 INNER JOIN lazy_sort_t2 AS t2 ON t2.c1 = t1.c1 INNER JOIN lazy_sort_t3 AS t3 ON t3.c1 = t1.c1 WHERE (t1.c2 NOT LIKE '%zzz%') AND (t1.c10 != 'q') AND (t2.c2 > 0) AND (t3.c2 >= '2024-01-01') AND (t3.c2 < today()) ORDER BY a9 ASC FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.body, c.created, c.author FROM lazy_sort_posts AS p INNER JOIN lazy_sort_comments AS c ON c.post_id = p.id ORDER BY c.created FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.body, c.created, c.author FROM lazy_sort_posts AS p INNER JOIN lazy_sort_comments AS c ON c.post_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id, c.created FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false
